```{r Project Setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# This chunk sets up paths using the global project_dirs object
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(gt)
library(plotly)
library(glue)
library(webshot2)
# Explicitly load key tidyverse sub-packages for knitr environment robustness
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Ensure global project_dirs object exists
if (!exists("project_dirs", envir = .GlobalEnv) || !is.list(project_dirs)) {
  stop("Global object 'project_dirs' not found or is not a list. Run MultiScholaR::setupDirectories() first.")
}

# Use the getProjectPaths helper function which handles key fallback
if (!exists("getProjectPaths", mode = "function")) {
  stop("getProjectPaths function not found. Ensure MultiScholaR package is loaded.")
}

current_project_paths <- tryCatch({
  getProjectPaths(
    omic_type = params$omic_type,
    experiment_label = params$experiment_label,
    project_dirs_object_name = "project_dirs",
    env = .GlobalEnv
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  stop(glue::glue("Failed to get project paths for omic_type='{params$omic_type}', experiment_label='{params$experiment_label}': {e$message}"))
})

# Verify we got valid paths
if (is.null(current_project_paths) || !is.list(current_project_paths)) {
  stop("getProjectPaths returned NULL or invalid data. Check project_dirs setup.")
}

# Define commonly used paths for this report
report_source_dir             <- current_project_paths$source_dir
report_results_summary_dir    <- current_project_paths$results_summary_dir
report_qc_figures_dir         <- current_project_paths$qc_figures_dir
report_publication_figures_dir<- current_project_paths$publication_figures_dir
report_publication_tables_dir <- current_project_paths$publication_tables_dir

# Basic validation
if (!dir.exists(report_source_dir)) stop(glue::glue("Report source directory not found: {report_source_dir}"))
if (!dir.exists(report_results_summary_dir)) stop(glue::glue("Report results summary directory not found: {report_results_summary_dir}"))

# Define the safe default operator %||%
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# D66 Debug log file
d66_log_file <- file.path(report_source_dir, "D66_debug.log")
d66_log <- function(...) {
  msg <- paste0(Sys.time(), " | ", paste(..., collapse = " "), "\n")
  cat(msg, file = d66_log_file, append = TRUE)
}
# Initialize log file
cat("=== D66 DEBUG LOG ===\n", file = d66_log_file)
d66_log("Log initialized")
```

```{r Hierarchical Parser, echo=FALSE}
# Hierarchical parser for study_parameters.txt format
ReadStudyParamsNew <- function(filepath) {
  if (!file.exists(filepath)) {
    stop(glue::glue("Study parameters file not found: {filepath}"))
  }

  lines <- readLines(filepath, warn = FALSE)
  params <- list()

  # State variables for hierarchical parsing
  main_section <- NULL
  sub_section <- NULL
  config_block <- NULL
  in_contrasts <- FALSE

  for (line in lines) {
    original_line <- line
    line <- trimws(line)

    # Skip empty lines, separator lines, and title
    if (line == "" || grepl("^=+$", line) || grepl("^-+$", line) ||
        line == "Study Parameters" || grepl("^#+", line)) {
      next
    }

    # Detect main sections
    if (grepl(":$", line) && !grepl("^[[:space:]]", original_line)) {
      # Strip bullet prefix and trailing colon from section name
      main_section <- trimws(sub("^[-•*][[:space:]]*", "", sub(":$", "", line)))
      d66_log("[D66] MAIN SECTION detected:", main_section, "\n")
      params[[main_section]] <- list()
      sub_section <- NULL
      config_block <- NULL
      in_contrasts <- (main_section == "Contrasts")
      next
    }

    # Detect sub-sections
    if (grepl(":$", line) && grepl("^[[:space:]]+", original_line)) {
      # Strip bullet prefix and trailing colon from sub-section name
      sub_section <- trimws(sub("^[-•][[:space:]]*", "", sub(":$", "", line)))
      d66_log("[D66] SUB-SECTION detected:", sub_section, "under main:", main_section, "\n")
      if (!is.null(main_section)) {
        if (is.null(params[[main_section]])) {
          params[[main_section]] <- list()
        }
        params[[main_section]][[sub_section]] <- list()
      }
      config_block <- NULL
      next
    }

    # Detect config blocks
    if (grepl("^\\[.*\\]$", line)) {
      config_block <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", line)
      if (!is.null(sub_section) && !is.null(main_section)) {
        params[[main_section]][[sub_section]][[config_block]] <- list()
      } else if (!is.null(main_section)) {
        params[[main_section]][[config_block]] <- list()
      }
      next
    }

    # Handle contrasts
    if (in_contrasts && main_section == "Contrasts") {
      if (line != "" && !grepl("^-+$", line)) {
        if (is.list(params[[main_section]]) && length(params[[main_section]]) == 0) {
          params[[main_section]] <- c(trimws(line))
        } else {
          params[[main_section]] <- c(params[[main_section]], trimws(line))
        }
      }
      next
    }

    # Handle bullet points and dash-prefixed lines (e.g., "• Item" or "- Item")
    # Note: "-" must be at start or end of character class to be literal
    if (grepl("^[•*-]", line)) {
      line <- sub("^[-•*][[:space:]]*", "", line)
    }

    # Handle key-value pairs
    if (grepl("[=:]", line)) {
      # Split on the FIRST occurring delimiter to handle cases like "LCMS_Pos: k=2, controls=19"
      colon_pos <- regexpr(":", line)[1]
      equals_pos <- regexpr("=", line)[1]
      # Use colon if it comes first (or if no equals), otherwise use equals
      split_char <- if (colon_pos > 0 && (equals_pos < 0 || colon_pos < equals_pos)) ":" else "="
      parts <- stringr::str_split_fixed(line, split_char, 2)
      key <- trimws(parts[1, 1])
      value <- trimws(parts[1, 2])

      key <- sub("^[•*[:space:]-]+", "", key)

      if (nchar(key) > 0) {
        if (!is.null(config_block) && !is.null(sub_section) && !is.null(main_section)) {
          d66_log("[D66] KEY-VALUE in config:", main_section, "/", sub_section, "/", config_block, ":", key, "=", value, "\n")
          params[[main_section]][[sub_section]][[config_block]][[key]] <- value
        } else if (!is.null(sub_section) && !is.null(main_section)) {
          d66_log("[D66] KEY-VALUE in sub-section:", main_section, "/", sub_section, ":", key, "=", value, "\n")
          params[[main_section]][[sub_section]][[key]] <- value
        } else if (!is.null(main_section)) {
          d66_log("[D66] KEY-VALUE in main:", main_section, ":", key, "=", value, "\n")
          params[[main_section]][[key]] <- value
        }
      }
    }
  }

  d66_log("[D66] ReadStudyParamsNew finished. Top-level sections:", paste(names(params), collapse=", "), "\n")
  if (!is.null(params$"RUV-III Batch Correction")) {
    d66_log("[D66] RUV-III section keys:", paste(names(params$"RUV-III Batch Correction"), collapse=", "), "\n")
    if (!is.null(params$"RUV-III Batch Correction"$"Per-Assay Parameters")) {
      d66_log("[D66] Per-Assay Parameters keys:", paste(names(params$"RUV-III Batch Correction"$"Per-Assay Parameters"), collapse=", "), "\n")
    }
  }
  return(params)
}

# Safe parameter extraction
safe_extract <- function(params, path, default = NULL) {
  if (is.null(params) || is.null(path)) return(default)

  if (is.character(path) && length(path) == 1 && grepl("\\|", path)) {
    path_parts <- strsplit(path, "\\|")[[1]]
  } else if (is.character(path)) {
    path_parts <- path
  } else {
    return(default)
  }

  current <- params
  for (part in path_parts) {
    part <- trimws(part)
    if (is.list(current) && part %in% names(current)) {
      current <- current[[part]]
    } else {
      return(default)
    }
  }

  return(current)
}

# Convert "Yes"/"No" strings to logical values
# Handles various string representations of booleans
parse_yes_no <- function(value, default = FALSE) {
    if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0) return(default)
    if (is.na(value)) return(default)
    if (is.logical(value)) return(value)
    if (is.character(value)) {
        return(tolower(trimws(value)) %in% c("yes", "true", "1", "applied"))
    }
    return(as.logical(value))
}

# Parse per-assay RUV parameters from "RUV-III Batch Correction" section
# Handles format like: "LCMS_Pos: k=2, controls=19"
# Returns structured data for per-assay formatting
parse_per_assay_ruv <- function(ruv_section) {
    result <- list(
        total_k = NA,
        total_controls = NA,
        per_assay_text = NA,
        grouping_variable = NA,
        assay_list = list()  # Structured per-assay data
    )
    
    d66_log("[D66] parse_per_assay_ruv called\n")
    d66_log("[D66] ruv_section is NULL:", is.null(ruv_section), "\n")
    d66_log("[D66] ruv_section length:", length(ruv_section), "\n")
    d66_log("[D66] ruv_section names:", paste(names(ruv_section), collapse=", "), "\n")
    
    if (is.null(ruv_section) || length(ruv_section) == 0) return(result)
    
    # Extract grouping variable
    result$grouping_variable <- ruv_section$"Grouping Variable" %||% NA
    d66_log("[D66] grouping_variable:", result$grouping_variable, "\n")
    
    # Look for per-assay parameters in various formats
    # Format 1: Named elements like "LCMS_Pos" with value "k=2, controls=19"
    # Format 2: "Per-Assay Parameters" sub-section
    per_assay_sub <- ruv_section$"Per-Assay Parameters"
    d66_log("[D66] Per-Assay Parameters sub-section is NULL:", is.null(per_assay_sub), "\n")
    if (!is.null(per_assay_sub)) {
        d66_log("[D66] Per-Assay Parameters names:", paste(names(per_assay_sub), collapse=", "), "\n")
    }
    per_assay <- per_assay_sub %||% ruv_section
    d66_log("[D66] per_assay names:", paste(names(per_assay), collapse=", "), "\n")
    
    # Find assay entries (keys that look like assay names, not metadata keys)
    metadata_keys <- c("Status", "Grouping Variable", "Per-Assay Parameters")
    assay_keys <- setdiff(names(per_assay), metadata_keys)
    d66_log("[D66] assay_keys after setdiff:", paste(assay_keys, collapse=", "), "\n")
    
    if (length(assay_keys) > 0) {
        d66_log("[D66] Processing", length(assay_keys), "assay keys\n")
        total_k <- 0
        total_controls <- 0
        assay_details <- c()
        assay_list <- list()
        
        for (assay_name in assay_keys) {
            val <- per_assay[[assay_name]]
            d66_log("[D66] Assay:", assay_name, "| val class:", class(val), "| val:", as.character(val)[1], "\n")
            if (is.character(val)) {
                # Parse "k=2, controls=19" format
                k_match <- regmatches(val, regexpr("k=([0-9]+)", val))
                ctrl_match <- regmatches(val, regexpr("controls=([0-9]+)", val))
                
                k_val <- if (length(k_match) > 0) as.numeric(sub("k=", "", k_match)) else NA
                ctrl_val <- if (length(ctrl_match) > 0) as.numeric(sub("controls=", "", ctrl_match)) else NA
                d66_log("[D66]   k_val:", k_val, "| ctrl_val:", ctrl_val, "\n")
                
                if (!is.na(k_val)) total_k <- max(total_k, k_val, na.rm = TRUE)
                if (!is.na(ctrl_val)) total_controls <- total_controls + ctrl_val
                
                assay_details <- c(assay_details, paste0(assay_name, ": ", val))
                
                # Store structured per-assay data
                assay_list[[assay_name]] <- list(k = k_val, controls = ctrl_val)
            }
        }
        
        result$total_k <- if (total_k > 0) total_k else NA
        result$total_controls <- if (total_controls > 0) total_controls else NA
        result$per_assay_text <- paste(assay_details, collapse = "; ")
        result$assay_list <- assay_list
        d66_log("[D66] Final assay_list names:", paste(names(assay_list), collapse=", "), "\n")
        d66_log("[D66] Final assay_list length:", length(assay_list), "\n")
    } else {
        d66_log("[D66] No assay keys found!\n")
    }
    
    return(result)
}

# Enhanced parameter extraction for metabolomics
ExtractStudyParametersNew <- function(study_params) {

  # Extract from different sections
  basic_info <- study_params$"Basic Information" %||% list()
  
  # Version info - try new name first, fall back to old name for backwards compatibility
  version_info <- study_params$"Version Information" %||% 
                  study_params$"Git Information" %||% list()
  
  # RUV sections - try new format first, fall back to old format
  ruv_batch_correction <- study_params$"RUV-III Batch Correction" %||% list()
  ruv_results <- study_params$"Automatic RUV Optimization Results" %||% list()

  # Metabolomics-specific sections
  assay_info <- study_params$"Assay Information" %||% list()
  itsd_info <- study_params$"ITSD Normalization" %||% list()
  log_transform_info <- study_params$"Log Transformation" %||% list()
  norm_info <- study_params$"Between-Sample Normalization" %||% list()
  metab_metadata <- study_params$"Metabolomics Metadata" %||% list()

  # Navigate to S4 parameters
  s4_params <- safe_extract(study_params, c("Workflow Parameters", "Parameters from Final S4 Object"), list())

  # Navigate to UI parameters
  ui_params <- safe_extract(study_params, c("Workflow Parameters", "User Interface Parameters"), list())

  # Extract contrasts
  contrasts <- study_params$"Contrasts" %||% character(0)

  # Extract S4 parameter sections
  s4_global <- s4_params$globalParameters %||% list()
  s4_itsd <- s4_params$ITSDNormalization %||% list()
  s4_norm <- s4_params$normaliseBetweenSamples %||% list()
  s4_ruv <- s4_params$ruvIII_C_Varying %||% list()
  s4_de <- s4_params$deAnalysisParameters %||% list()
  
  # Also check for per-assay RUV params stored directly in S4
  s4_ruv_k <- s4_params$ruv_number_k %||% list()
  s4_ruv_ctrl <- s4_params$ctrl %||% list()

  # Extract UI parameter sections
  # KIT-236 (P03, I10): the DA UI block the application writes is named "Differential Expression UI Parameters"
  # (the only name any writer has used); the name read before, "Differential Abundance", is never written.
  ui_de <- safe_extract(ui_params, "Differential Abundance UI Parameters", NULL) %||%
    safe_extract(ui_params, "Differential Expression UI Parameters", list())
  ui_enrich <- safe_extract(ui_params, "Enrichment Analysis UI Parameters", list())
  
  # Parse per-assay RUV parameters from the new format
  # Note: Due to txt file formatting, "Per-Assay Parameters" may be parsed as 
  # a separate top-level section instead of a sub-section of RUV-III Batch Correction
  per_assay_section <- study_params$"Per-Assay Parameters" %||% 
                       ruv_batch_correction$"Per-Assay Parameters" %||% 
                       list()
  d66_log("[D66] ExtractStudyParametersNew: per_assay_section names:", paste(names(per_assay_section), collapse=", "))
  
  # Merge per_assay_section into ruv_batch_correction for parsing
  ruv_with_per_assay <- ruv_batch_correction
  if (length(per_assay_section) > 0) {
    ruv_with_per_assay$"Per-Assay Parameters" <- per_assay_section
  }
  
  parsed_ruv <- parse_per_assay_ruv(ruv_with_per_assay)

  # Create flat parameter list
  all_params <- list(
    # Basic Information
    workflow_name = basic_info$"Workflow Name",
    description = basic_info$"Description",
    timestamp = basic_info$"Timestamp",

    # Version/Git Information - try new keys first, fall back to old keys
    repository = version_info$"Repository",
    branch = version_info$"Branch",
    commit = version_info$"Commit",
    git_timestamp = version_info$"Commit Timestamp" %||% version_info$"Git Timestamp",

    # Assay Information
    num_assays = assay_info$"Number of Assays" %||% NA,
    assay_names = assay_info$"Assay Names" %||% NA,
    total_metabolites = assay_info$"Total Unique Metabolites" %||% NA,

    # ITSD Normalization (use parse_yes_no for boolean conversion)
    itsd_applied = parse_yes_no(itsd_info$"Applied", FALSE),
    itsd_method_type = itsd_info$"Method Type" %||% NA,
    itsd_aggregation = itsd_info$"Aggregation" %||% NA,
    itsd_removed = parse_yes_no(itsd_info$"ITSD Removed After Normalization", FALSE),
    itsd_features_per_assay = itsd_info$"ITSD Features Per Assay" %||% NA,

    # Log Transformation
    log_transform_applied = parse_yes_no(log_transform_info$"Applied", TRUE),
    log_transform_offset = log_transform_info$"Offset" %||% 0,

    # Between-Sample Normalization
    normalisation_method = norm_info$"Method" %||% s4_norm$method %||% "cyclicloess",

    # RUV Status - check multiple possible sources
    # KIT-227: the writer's '* Status' line too (this parser keeps the '*' in the key); NA = not recorded (was FALSE)
    ruv_applied = if (!is.null(ruv_batch_correction$"Status" %||% ruv_batch_correction$"* Status")) {
      parse_yes_no(ruv_batch_correction$"Status" %||% ruv_batch_correction$"* Status", FALSE)
    } else if (!is.null(ruv_results$"Best k value")) {
      TRUE
    } else if (!is.na(parsed_ruv$total_k)) {
      TRUE
    } else if (length(s4_ruv_k) > 0 && !all(sapply(s4_ruv_k, is.null))) {
      TRUE
    } else {
      NA
    },

    # RUV Results - try new per-assay format first, fall back to old format
    best_percentage = ruv_results$"Best percentage" %||% NA,
    best_k = parsed_ruv$total_k %||% ruv_results$"Best k value" %||% NA,
    separation_score = ruv_results$"Separation score" %||% NA,
    composite_score = ruv_results$"Composite score" %||% NA,
    num_neg_ctrl = parsed_ruv$total_controls %||% ruv_results$"Control features" %||% NA,
    ruv_grouping_variable = parsed_ruv$grouping_variable %||% ruv_results$"RUV grouping variable" %||% NA,
    ruv_per_assay_details = parsed_ruv$per_assay_text %||% NA,
    ruv_assay_list = parsed_ruv$assay_list,  # Structured per-assay data for formatting
    ruv_number_k = if (!is.na(parsed_ruv$total_k)) {
      parsed_ruv$total_k
    } else if (!is.null(s4_ruv$ruv_number_k) && !is.na(s4_ruv$ruv_number_k)) {
      as.numeric(s4_ruv$ruv_number_k)
    } else {
      2
    },

    # DE Analysis S4 parameters
    s4_de_q_val_thresh = if(is.null(s4_de$de_q_val_thresh) || is.na(s4_de$de_q_val_thresh)) 0.05 else as.numeric(s4_de$de_q_val_thresh),
    s4_de_treat_lfc_cutoff = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s4_de$treat_lfc_cutoff %||% NA_real_)), # KIT-236: NA = not recorded
    s4_ebayes_trend = as.logical(s4_de$eBayes_trend %||% TRUE),
    s4_ebayes_robust = as.logical(s4_de$eBayes_robust %||% TRUE),
    s4_formula_string = s4_de$formula_string %||% "~ 0 + group",

    # UI Parameters
    ui_de_q_value_threshold = if(is.null(ui_de$q_value_threshold) || is.na(ui_de$q_value_threshold)) 0.05 else as.numeric(ui_de$q_value_threshold),
    ui_de_log_fold_change_cutoff = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ui_de$log_fold_change_cutoff %||% NA_real_)), # KIT-236: NA = not recorded
    ui_de_treat_enabled = suppressWarnings(as.logical(ui_de$treat_enabled %||% NA)), # KIT-236: NA = not recorded

    ui_enrichment_up_lfc = if(is.null(ui_enrich$up_log2fc_cutoff) || is.na(ui_enrich$up_log2fc_cutoff)) 0 else as.numeric(ui_enrich$up_log2fc_cutoff),
    ui_enrichment_down_lfc = if(is.null(ui_enrich$down_log2fc_cutoff) || is.na(ui_enrich$down_log2fc_cutoff)) 0 else as.numeric(ui_enrich$down_log2fc_cutoff),
    ui_enrichment_q_value_cutoff = if(is.null(ui_enrich$q_value_cutoff) || is.na(ui_enrich$q_value_cutoff)) 0.05 else as.numeric(ui_enrich$q_value_cutoff),
    ui_enrichment_database_source = ui_enrich$database_source %||% "KEGG",

    # Contrasts
    contrasts = contrasts
  )

  # Convert any NULL values to NA
  all_params[sapply(all_params, is.null)] <- NA

  return(all_params)
}
```

```{r Format Sample Details, echo=FALSE}
FormatSampleDetails <- function(numbers) {
  # KIT-236 (D5, D14): the samples and technical replicates the analysed design declares (the record's design, else
  # the design table); the sample identification is a field for the analyst.
  design_text <- ReportDesignText(numbers$report_facts)

  glue::glue(
    "
SAMPLE DETAILS

{design_text}
• Sample identification, conditions upon receipt and any non-compliance notes: [to be completed by the analyst]  ",
    .trim = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r Method Section, echo=FALSE}
FormatMethodDetails <- function(numbers) {
  # Extract parameters
  num_assays <- numbers$num_assays %||% 1
  assay_names <- numbers$assay_names %||% "Unknown"
  norm_method <- numbers$normalisation_method %||% "cyclicloess"

  # ITSD normalization text
  itsd_text <- if (isTRUE(numbers$itsd_applied)) {
    itsd_method <- numbers$itsd_method_type %||% "average_centered"
    itsd_agg <- numbers$itsd_aggregation %||% "mean"
    itsd_removed_val <- numbers$itsd_removed %||% FALSE
    removal_text <- if (isTRUE(itsd_removed_val)) {
      "Internal standard features were removed after normalization."
    } else {
      "Internal standard features were retained in the dataset."
    }

    # Check for per-assay ITSD feature information
    itsd_feature_details <- ""
    if (!is.null(numbers$itsd_features_per_assay) && !is.na(numbers$itsd_features_per_assay)) {
      itsd_feature_details <- paste0(
        " The ITSD features used per assay were: ",
        numbers$itsd_features_per_assay,
        "."
      )
    }

    glue::glue(
      "Internal standard (ITSD) normalization was applied using the ",
      "{itsd_method} method with {itsd_agg} aggregation across ITSD features. ",
      "{removal_text}{itsd_feature_details}"
    )
  } else {
    "Internal standard normalization was not applied."
  }

  # Multi-assay text
  assay_text <- if (num_assays > 1) {
    glue::glue(
      "The dataset contains {num_assays} assays: {assay_names}. ",
      # KIT-236 (D6, I09): what is done per assay; there is no integration step. Not "removed from every assay": a
      # sample the correlation filter sets missing in one assay stays in the others (KIT-255).
      "Each assay was processed and tested for differential abundance separately; ",
      if (is.null(numbers$report_facts$failures)) "the results of the {num_assays} assays are reported together." else
        paste("the results are reported together for the assays and comparisons where the test could be computed",
          "(see Differential Abundance Analysis).")
    )
  } else {
    glue::glue("The dataset contains a single assay: {assay_names}.")
  }

  # KIT-236 (D12): the software the record names; the SOP is a field for the analyst.
  software_text <- if (ReportKnown(numbers$software_version)) {
    paste0(" ", numbers$software_version, if (ReportKnown(numbers$build)) paste0(" (build ", numbers$build, ")") else "")
  } else ""
  # KIT-236 (D7): how zeros were handled, stated only where KIT-172's log2 sentence does not already say it (an offset
  # above 0); with no log transformation nothing records it.
  log_offset_val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numbers$log_transform_offset %||% 0))
  zeros_text <- if (isTRUE(numbers$log_transform_applied) && !is.na(log_offset_val) && log_offset_val > 0) {
    paste(" Negative values were set to zero before the transformation, zeros were transformed with the offset, and",
      "cells with no value stayed missing.")
  } else ""
  # KIT-236 (D9): the assays must hold the same samples (the object's validity rule).
  same_samples_text <- if (isTRUE(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(num_assays)) > 1)) " The assays were required to contain the same samples." else ""

  # KIT-236 (D8, I12): "none" and "not recorded" say so; the sentence of a method applied is unchanged until KIT-242
  # (which decides what is said when a chosen method fails for an assay).
  norm_sentence <- if (!isTRUE(numbers$report_facts$normalisation_recorded %||% TRUE)) {
    "The between-sample normalisation method is not recorded for this analysis."
  } else if (identical(as.character(norm_method), "none")) {
    "No between-sample normalisation was applied."
  } else {
    glue::glue("Between-sample normalization was performed using the '{norm_method}' method from
the 'limma' R package (Ritchie et al., 2015) to account for systematic technical
variation across samples.")
  }

  # Log transformation text
  # KIT-172: plain log2 by default; a replayed record's offset is stated as the transform it was.
  log_text <- if (isTRUE(numbers$log_transform_applied)) {
    offset_val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numbers$log_transform_offset %||% 0))
    if (is.na(offset_val) || offset_val == 0) {
      paste("Intensities were log2-transformed; a value of zero was read as not detected and was not imputed, so a",
        "feature was tested only where it was measured, and a fold change can be underestimated when values fall below",
        "the detection limit in one group.")
    } else {
      glue::glue("Metabolite intensities were transformed as log2(x + {offset_val}).")
    }
  } else {
    "Data were analyzed on the original intensity scale without log transformation."
  }

  # RUV parameters - handle both old and new formats
  best_k_val <- numbers$best_k %||% numbers$ruv_number_k %||% NA
  best_pct_val <- numbers$best_percentage %||% NA
  num_neg_ctrl_val <- numbers$num_neg_ctrl %||% NA
  ruv_per_assay <- numbers$ruv_per_assay_details %||% NA
  ruv_grouping_var <- numbers$ruv_grouping_variable %||% "group"
  ruv_assay_list <- numbers$ruv_assay_list  # Structured per-assay data

  d66_log("[D66] FormatMethodDetails RUV params:\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   ruv_applied:", numbers$ruv_applied, "\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   ruv_assay_list is NULL:", is.null(ruv_assay_list), "\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   ruv_assay_list length:", length(ruv_assay_list), "\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   ruv_assay_list names:", paste(names(ruv_assay_list), collapse=", "), "\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   best_k_val:", best_k_val, "\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   best_pct_val:", best_pct_val, "\n")
  d66_log("[D66]   num_neg_ctrl_val:", num_neg_ctrl_val, "\n")

  # RUV text - adapt based on available information
  # Following proteomics pattern: describe each assay separately

  # KIT-227: the RUV paragraph states what was run: applied, not applied or not recorded; the design column that defined
  # the replicate samples (the record's, else the file's); the mode (the record's ruv_mode: manual = set by the
  # analyst). A value written as 'N/A' counts as not recorded. Automatic on the 'group' column keeps the earlier text.
  ruv_known <- function(value) !is.null(value) && length(value) == 1L && !is.na(value) &&
    !trimws(as.character(value)) %in% c("", "N/A", "NA", "not recorded")
  ruv_applied_val <- if (isTRUE(numbers$ruv_applied)) TRUE else if (isFALSE(numbers$ruv_applied)) FALSE else NA
  ruv_mode_val <- if (ruv_known(numbers$record_ruv_mode) && numbers$record_ruv_mode %in% c("automatic", "manual")) numbers$record_ruv_mode else NA
  ruv_grouping <- if (ruv_known(numbers$record_ruv_grouping)) numbers$record_ruv_grouping else numbers$ruv_grouping_variable
  ruv_other_column <- ruv_known(ruv_grouping) && !identical(as.character(ruv_grouping), "group")
  ruv_groups <- if (!ruv_known(ruv_grouping)) "the sample groups (the design column used is not recorded)" else
    if (ruv_other_column) paste0("the sample groups given by the design column '", ruv_grouping, "'") else "biological groups"

  ruv_text <- if (isTRUE(ruv_applied_val)) {
    d66_log("[D66] RUV applied is TRUE, checking ruv_assay_list\n")
    # Check if we have structured per-assay data (new format)
    if (!is.null(ruv_assay_list) && length(ruv_assay_list) > 0) {
      d66_log("[D66] Using per-assay format with", length(ruv_assay_list), "assays\n")
      # Build per-assay sentences like proteomics report
      per_assay_sentences <- sapply(names(ruv_assay_list), function(assay_name) {
        assay_data <- ruv_assay_list[[assay_name]]
        k_val <- assay_data$k
        ctrl_val <- assay_data$controls
        if (!is.na(k_val) && !is.na(ctrl_val)) {
          paste0("For ", assay_name, ", ", k_val, " unwanted components were removed using ", 
                 ctrl_val, " empirical negative control metabolites.")
        } else if (!is.na(k_val)) {
          paste0("For ", assay_name, ", ", k_val, " unwanted components were removed.")
        } else {
          NULL
        }
      })
      per_assay_sentences <- per_assay_sentences[!sapply(per_assay_sentences, is.null)]
      per_assay_text <- paste(per_assay_sentences, collapse = " ")
      
      ruv_grouping_text <- if (!ruv_known(ruv_grouping)) {
        "RUV correction was applied independently to each assay (the design column that defined the replicate samples is not recorded)."
      } else if (ruv_other_column) {
        paste0("RUV correction was applied independently to each assay. Samples with the same value of the design column '",
          ruv_grouping, "' were treated as replicates, so the differences between those values were kept and other ",
          "differences between samples could be removed as unwanted variation.")
      } else {
        paste0("RUV correction was applied independently to each assay using the '", ruv_grouping,
          "' variable to preserve biological signal.")
      }
      ruv_manual_text <- if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "manual")) paste0(" The number of unwanted components and the share ",
        "of features used as controls were set by the analyst; no automatic optimisation was run.") else ""
      glue::glue(
        "To remove batch effects from biological data, the remove unwanted variation ",
        "(RUVIII-C) method was used. The method relies on having a set of endogenous ",
        "negative control metabolites, which are features with little or no changes in ",
        "abundance between different samples. {ruv_grouping_text} {per_assay_text}{ruv_manual_text}"
      )
    } else if (!is.na(best_pct_val)) {
      # Old format with percentage (single-assay or legacy)
      ruv_pct <- if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "manual") && ruv_known(numbers$record_ruv_percentage)) numbers$record_ruv_percentage else best_pct_val
      ruv_controls <- if (ruv_known(num_neg_ctrl_val)) paste0(num_neg_ctrl_val, " metabolites") else "number of metabolites not recorded"
      ruv_share <- if (ruv_known(num_neg_ctrl_val)) paste0("(not recorded; ", num_neg_ctrl_val, " metabolites were used)") else
        "(not recorded, nor the number of metabolites used)"
      ruv_k_val <- if (ruv_known(best_k_val)) best_k_val else "an unrecorded number of"
      ruv_detail <- if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "automatic")) {
        if (ruv_known(ruv_pct)) glue::glue(
          "For this study, an automatic ",
          "optimization process identified that using {ruv_pct}% of ",
          "features as empirical negative controls ({ruv_controls}) ",
          "provided the best separation of {ruv_groups}. Based on this, ",
          "{ruv_k_val} unwanted components were selected for removal."
        ) else glue::glue(
          "For this study, an automatic optimization process selected the share of features used as empirical negative ",
          "controls {ruv_share} that provided the best separation of {ruv_groups}. Based on this, {ruv_k_val} unwanted ",
          "components were selected for removal."
        )
      } else if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "manual")) {
        paste0(if (ruv_known(ruv_pct)) glue::glue(
          "For this study, no automatic optimization was run: the analyst chose to use {ruv_pct}% of features as empirical ",
          "negative controls ({ruv_controls}) and to remove {ruv_k_val} unwanted components."
        ) else glue::glue(
          "For this study, no automatic optimization was run: the analyst set the share of features used as empirical ",
          "negative controls {ruv_share} and chose to remove {ruv_k_val} unwanted components."
        ), if (ruv_other_column) paste0(" The controls were chosen by comparing ", ruv_groups, ".") else "")
      } else {
        if (ruv_known(ruv_pct)) glue::glue(
          "For this study, {ruv_pct}% of features were used as empirical negative controls ({ruv_controls}) and ",
          "{ruv_k_val} unwanted components were removed; whether these values came from an automatic optimization or ",
          "were set by the analyst is not recorded."
        ) else glue::glue(
          "For this study, a share of features {ruv_share} served as empirical negative controls and {ruv_k_val} unwanted ",
          "components were removed; whether these values came from an automatic optimization or were set by the analyst ",
          "is not recorded."
        )
      }
      glue::glue(
        "To remove batch effects from biological data, the remove unwanted variation ",
        "(RUVIII-C) method was used. The method relies on having a set of endogenous ",
        "negative control metabolites, which are features with little or no changes in ",
        "abundance between different samples. {ruv_detail}"
      )
    } else {
      # Minimal info available - try to use what we have
      k_text <- if (!is.na(best_k_val)) paste0(best_k_val, " unwanted components were removed") else "unwanted variation was removed"
      ctrl_text <- if (!is.na(num_neg_ctrl_val)) paste0("using ", num_neg_ctrl_val, " empirical negative control metabolites") else "using empirical negative controls"
      glue::glue(
        "To remove batch effects from biological data, the remove unwanted variation ",
        "(RUVIII-C) method was used. The method relies on having a set of endogenous ",
        "negative control metabolites, which are features with little or no changes in ",
        "abundance between different samples. For this study, {k_text} {ctrl_text}."
      )
    }
  } else if (isFALSE(ruv_applied_val)) {
    "RUV-III batch correction was not applied. The analysis proceeded directly with normalized data for differential abundance analysis."
  } else {
    "Whether RUV-III batch correction was applied is not recorded for this analysis."
  }

  glue::glue("
METHOD DETAILS

Data analyses were performed with MultiScholaR{software_text}; SOP reference: [to be completed by the analyst].

Multi-Assay Data Structure
{assay_text}

Data Preprocessing and Normalization
{log_text}{zeros_text}

ITSD Normalization
{itsd_text}

{norm_sentence}

Batch Effect Correction
{numbers$ruv_design_methods %||% ruv_text}

Quality Control
At each stage of data normalization, samples were checked for batch effects using:
• Principal component analysis (PCA) to visualize sample clustering
• Density boxplots to assess distribution consistency
• Relative log-expression (RLE) plots to detect systematic biases
• Pearson correlation matrices to evaluate replicate consistency

Per-Assay Quality Metrics
Per-assay quality control: the quality-control figures were drawn separately for each assay.{same_samples_text}

Test conditions, deviations from the method and critical reagent details: [to be completed by the analyst].  ",
.trim = FALSE)
}
```

```{r Result Section, echo=FALSE}
FormatResults <- function(correlation_data,
                         figures_dir = file.path(results_dir, "metabolite_qc"),
                         ruv_applied = TRUE, numbers = NULL) {

  ruv_state <- if (isTRUE(ruv_applied)) TRUE else if (isFALSE(ruv_applied)) FALSE else NA # KIT-227: NA = not recorded
  # KIT-236 (D1, D2, F5): the caption describes the panels and the stages that were run, without panel letters (they
  # run assay by assay) and without a conclusion; when the composite figure was not written, it says so.
  if (!is.na(ruv_state)) {
    composite <- ReportFileState("report_qc_figures_dir", paste0(params$omic_type, "_composite_QC_figure.png"))
    facts <- numbers$report_facts
    itsd_found <- isTRUE(numbers$itsd_applied) && isTRUE((facts$itsd_assays_found %||% 0) > 0)
    log_applied <- isTRUE(numbers$log_transform_applied)
    before <- if (itsd_found && log_applied) " before internal-standard normalisation and log2 transformation" else
      if (itsd_found) " before internal-standard normalisation" else if (log_applied) " before log2 transformation" else ""
    method_words <- ReportNormalisationWords(numbers$normalisation_method, facts$normalisation_recorded %||% TRUE)
    stages <- if (isTRUE(ruv_state)) {
      paste0("after ", method_words, " (centre); after RUVIII-C correction (right).")
    } else {
      paste0("after ", method_words, " (right). RUV-III correction was not applied to this dataset.")
    }
    caption <- if (isFALSE(composite)) "The quality-control figure was not produced for this analysis." else paste0(
      "Figure 1 has one row per assay and view (for each assay in turn: principal component analysis; density ",
      "boxplots of the samples' scores on the first two principal components; relative log expression; Pearson ",
      "correlation) and one column per stage: after filtering, on the intensities", before, " (left); ", stages,
      " Whether technical variation was reduced and biological signal kept is for the analyst to judge from these ",
      "panels; this report draws no conclusion from them.")
    return(paste0("\nQuality Control\n\nQuality Control Analysis\n", caption, " "))
  }
  if (is.na(ruv_state)) {
    # KIT-227: RUV not recorded: the figure's column layout is not known, so no stages are named.
    glue::glue("
Quality Control

Quality Control Analysis
Figure 1 shows four quality-control views at each stage of processing drawn for this analysis. Whether RUV-III
correction was applied is not recorded for this analysis.
• Principal component analysis (PCA) to visualize sample clustering
• Density boxplots to assess distribution consistency
• Relative log-expression (RLE) plots to detect systematic biases
• Pearson correlation matrices to evaluate replicate consistency ",
      .trim = FALSE
    )
  }
}

```{r Comment Section, echo=FALSE}
FormatComments <- function(numbers = NULL) {
  # KIT-236 (D3, OD-1 / VAL-245): no finding is printed that the analysis did not compute. Beside the analyst's field,
  # the counts the record holds, with no judgement: the features remaining after each step, and (only with a record,
  # and only when the step ran) the samples the sample-correlation filter kept.
  facts <- numbers$report_facts
  counts <- character()
  if (isTRUE(facts$record_present) && !is.null(facts$step_features)) {
    n_assays <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numbers$num_assays))
    counts <- c(counts, paste0("Features remaining after each step",
      if (isTRUE(n_assays > 1)) paste0(" (total across the ", n_assays, " assays)") else "", ": ", facts$step_features, "."))
  }
  if (isTRUE(facts$record_present) && !is.null(facts$samples_kept)) {
    kept <- facts$samples_kept
    # KIT-255 (VAL-283, DRAFT wording): the samples the filter set missing in one assay stay in the analysis of the others.
    set_missing <- facts$samples_set_missing
    counts <- c(counts, paste0(kept$k, " of ", kept$n, " samples were kept by the sample-correlation filter",
      if (ReportKnown(kept$threshold)) paste0(" (threshold ", kept$threshold, ")") else "",
      if (length(set_missing)) paste0("; ", length(set_missing), if (length(set_missing) == 1L) " sample was" else " samples were",
        " excluded in one assay only (", paste(set_missing, collapse = ", "), ")") else "", "."))
  }
  field <- paste0("[To be completed by the analyst: quality-control assessment from Figure 1, technical performance and ",
    "limitations of this data set. ", if (length(counts)) "Apart from the counts above, nothing" else "Nothing",
    " in this section is generated automatically.]")
  paste0("\nCOMMENTS\n\n", if (length(counts)) paste0(paste(counts, collapse = " "), "\n\n") else "", field, " ")
}

```{r Differential Abundance Section, echo=FALSE}
FormatDEDetails <- function(numbers) {
  # Get UI parameters with S4 fallbacks
  ui_q_val_thresh <- numbers$ui_de_q_value_threshold %||% numbers$s4_de_q_val_thresh %||% 0.05

  # S4 parameters
  ebayes_trend_val <- numbers$s4_ebayes_trend %||% TRUE
  ebayes_robust_val <- numbers$s4_ebayes_robust %||% TRUE
  formula_string_val <- numbers$s4_formula_string %||% "~ 0 + group"

  # KIT-236 (D20, D21): the fold-change threshold as it was tested (the record's model, else the DA UI block under
  # either name, else the cutoff), and the definition of a significant feature with it.
  treat <- ReportTreatState(numbers)
  treat_desc <- ReportTreatSentence(treat)
  significance_text <- ReportSignificanceSentence(treat, ui_q_val_thresh, "metabolites")

  trend_robust <- c()
  if (isTRUE(ebayes_trend_val)) trend_robust <- c(trend_robust, "trended")
  if (isTRUE(ebayes_robust_val)) trend_robust <- c(trend_robust, "robust")

  trend_robust_text <- if (length(trend_robust) > 0) {
    paste("A", paste(trend_robust, collapse = " and "), "empirical Bayes analysis was performed.")
  } else {
    "A standard empirical Bayes analysis was performed."
  }

  # KIT-236 (D15, D17): the volcano plots and the results table are named only when they are there.
  outputs <- c(
    if (length(ReportImages("report_publication_figures_dir", "Volcano_Plots"))) paste0("Volcano plots of differentially ",
      "abundant metabolites are shown in Figure 3, with a threshold of q-value < ", ui_q_val_thresh,
      ReportFoldChangeCriterion(treat), "."),
    if (isTRUE(ReportFileState("report_publication_tables_dir", paste0("DA_results_", params$omic_type, ".xlsx")))) {
      paste0("Full details of all metabolites are provided in the supplementary results table DA_results_", params$omic_type,
        ".xlsx within the Publication_tables folder.")
    })
  outputs_text <- if (length(outputs)) paste0("\n\n", paste(outputs, collapse = " ")) else ""
  # KIT-236 (D10, D11): the comparisons of the contrast table, the technical-replicate block and the FDR method.
  contrast_text <- ReportContrastList(numbers)
  block_text <- ReportBlockClause(numbers)
  fdr_text <- ReportFdrSentence(numbers)
  # KIT-236 (I01): under the declared RUV design the uncorrected values were tested with each assay's factors in the
  # model; (I06) the p-values are TREAT's at a fold-change threshold; (I09) a comparison whose test failed is named.
  declared <- numbers$report_facts$ruv_declared
  declared_none <- !is.null(declared) && identical(declared$design, "none")
  matrix_text <- if (is.null(declared)) "using the adjusted abundance matrix" else if (declared_none) {
    "on the normalised abundance matrix, with no RUV factors (the declared RUV design 'none')"
  } else {
    k <- declared$k
    k_text <- if (length(k) && !all(is.na(k))) paste0(" (", paste0(names(k), ": ", k, " factors", collapse = "; "), ")") else ""
    paste0("on the uncorrected abundance matrix, with each assay's RUV factors as covariates in the model", k_text)
  }
  formula_text <- if (is.null(declared) || declared_none) paste0("'", formula_string_val, "'") else
    paste0("'", formula_string_val, "' plus each assay's RUV factors")
  pvalue_text <- ReportPvalueClause(treat)
  failure_text <- ReportFailureText(numbers)

  glue::glue("
DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE ANALYSIS

Differential abundance of metabolites was tested separately within each assay, {matrix_text},
for the comparisons defined in the contrast table{contrast_text}. The 'limma' R package (Ritchie et al., 2015) was
used. A linear model was fitted using the formula {formula_text} with the 'lmFit' function, and {pvalue_text}.{block_text}{failure_text}
{trend_robust_text} {fdr_text}
{treat_desc} {significance_text}{outputs_text}",
    .trim = FALSE
  )
}
```

FormatPathwayEnrichment <- function(numbers) {
  # Get UI enrichment parameters
  up_lfc_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_up_lfc %||% 0
  down_lfc_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_down_lfc %||% 0
  q_val_cutoff_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_q_value_cutoff %||% 0.05
  database_source_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_database_source %||% "KEGG"

  # Text for LFC cutoffs
  lfc_text <- if (up_lfc_val > 0 || down_lfc_val < 0) {
      glue::glue(
          "• Upregulated metabolites were defined as those with a log2 fold-change > {up_lfc_val}. ",
          "Downregulated metabolites were defined as those with a log2 fold-change < {down_lfc_val}."
      )
  } else {
      "• No fold change cutoff was applied to filter differentially abundant metabolites."
  }

  enrichment_tool_text <- glue::glue(
    "The enrichment analysis was performed using {database_source_val} pathway databases. ",
    "Pathways were considered significantly enriched if they had an adjusted p-value ",
    "less than {q_val_cutoff_val} after multiple testing correction using the ",
    "Benjamini-Hochberg method."
  )

  glue::glue("
PATHWAY ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS

Pathway enrichment analysis was performed on the differentially abundant
metabolites to identify significantly enriched metabolic pathways and biological
processes. The analysis was conducted using the following parameters:
{lfc_text}
• An adjusted FDR cutoff of {q_val_cutoff_val} was used to identify significantly enriched pathways
• The background metabolite set consisted of all identified metabolites that
  passed quality control filtering steps

{enrichment_tool_text}

Key findings from the pathway enrichment analysis are summarized below for each
comparison:



The complete list of enriched pathways with statistics is provided in the
supplementary file 'Pathway_enrichment_results_metabolomics.xlsx' within the
Publication_tables folder.",
.trim = FALSE)
}

```{r Sample Analysis Functions, echo=FALSE}
# KIT-236: the facts the report's computed sentences read. The analysis record beside study_parameters.txt is read
# here directly (as KIT-227 reads its steps; the overlay maps none of these fields), then the design table, then the
# file. A source that is absent leaves its field NULL or NA, and the sentence says it is not recorded or is left out.
ReportKnown <- function(x) {
  !is.null(x) && length(x) == 1L && !is.list(x) && !is.na(x) &&
    !trimws(as.character(x)) %in% c("", "N/A", "NA", "not recorded")
}

#' A file's state: TRUE or FALSE when the report's directory is known, NA when it is not (a chunk run alone)
ReportFileState <- function(dir_name, file) {
  base <- get0(dir_name, ifnotfound = NULL)
  if (is.null(base)) return(NA)
  file.exists(file.path(base, file))
}

#' The image files in a report directory's subfolder (none when the directory is not known)
ReportImages <- function(dir_name, folder) {
  base <- get0(dir_name, ifnotfound = NULL)
  if (is.null(base)) return(character())
  list.files(file.path(base, folder), pattern = "[.](png|jpg|jpeg)$", ignore.case = TRUE)
}

ReportRecordFacts <- function(design_matrix, study_params) {
  source_dir <- get0("report_source_dir", ifnotfound = NULL)
  record_path <- if (is.null(source_dir)) "" else file.path(source_dir, "analysis_record.json")
  record <- if (nzchar(record_path) && file.exists(record_path)) {
    tryCatch(jsonlite::read_json(record_path, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL
  decode <- function(value) tryCatch(MultiScholaR:::decodeWorkflowRecordValue(value), error = function(e) NULL)
  facts <- list(record_present = !is.null(record))
  # The design: the record's analysed rows, else the design table. A technical-replicate set is a value of the
  # declared technical_replicate_id (tech_rep_group on the application's route) shared by two or more runs.
  rows <- record$design$rows
  if (length(rows)) {
    column <- record$design$technical_replicate_id
    ids <- if (ReportKnown(column)) vapply(rows, function(row) {
      value <- row[[column]]
      if (is.null(value)) NA_character_ else as.character(value)
    }, "") else NULL
    facts$design <- list(source = "record", runs = length(rows), ids = ids)
  } else if (is.data.frame(design_matrix) && nrow(design_matrix) > 0L) {
    ids <- if ("tech_rep_group" %in% names(design_matrix)) as.character(design_matrix$tech_rep_group) else NULL
    facts$design <- list(source = "file", runs = nrow(design_matrix), ids = ids)
  }
  da <- record$analyses$differential_abundance
  model <- da$model
  facts$treat_applied <- if (is.logical(model$treat_applied) && length(model$treat_applied) == 1L) model$treat_applied else NA
  facts$block_reason <- if (ReportKnown(model$block_reason)) as.character(model$block_reason) else NA_character_
  # The comparisons: the record's, else contrast_strings.tab beside the file, else the summary's contrasts_tbl.tab.
  raw <- character()
  friendly <- character()
  if (length(da$contrasts)) {
    raw <- vapply(da$contrasts, function(x) as.character(x$contrasts %||% NA_character_), "")
    friendly <- vapply(da$contrasts, function(x) as.character(x$friendly_names %||% x$contrasts %||% NA_character_), "")
  } else {
    strings_path <- if (is.null(source_dir)) "" else file.path(source_dir, "contrast_strings.tab")
    summary_dir <- get0("report_results_summary_dir", ifnotfound = NULL)
    table_path <- if (is.null(summary_dir)) "" else file.path(summary_dir, "Study_report", "contrasts_tbl.tab")
    if (nzchar(strings_path) && file.exists(strings_path)) {
      raw <- trimws(readLines(strings_path, warn = FALSE))
      raw <- raw[nzchar(raw)]
      friendly <- gsub(".", "_", gsub("-", "_vs_", gsub("-group", "-", gsub("^group", "", raw))), fixed = TRUE)
    } else if (nzchar(table_path) && file.exists(table_path)) {
      table <- tryCatch(utils::read.delim(table_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.data.frame(table) && nrow(table) > 0L) {
        raw <- as.character(table[[if ("contrasts" %in% names(table)) "contrasts" else 1L]])
        friendly <- if ("friendly_names" %in% names(table)) as.character(table$friendly_names) else raw
      }
    }
  }
  facts$contrasts <- stats::setNames(friendly, raw)
  # The FDR method of each comparison (and assay), where the record carries it.
  results <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x$fdr_method), da$results %||% list())
  if (length(results)) {
    facts$fdr <- data.frame(
      contrast = vapply(results, function(x) as.character(x$contrast %||% NA_character_), ""),
      assay = vapply(results, function(x) as.character(x$assay %||% NA_character_), ""),
      fdr_method = vapply(results, function(x) as.character(x$fdr_method), ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  # The features remaining after each step: the record's step dimensions (rows, summed over the assays).
  steps <- record$steps %||% list()
  labels <- c(design_builder = "import and design", intensity_filter = "intensity filter",
    duplicate_resolution = "duplicate resolution", qc_finalize = "quality-control finalisation",
    itsd_normalisation = "internal-standard normalisation", log2 = "log2 transformation",
    between_sample_normalisation = "between-sample normalisation", ruv = "RUV correction",
    pearson_selection = "sample-correlation filter")
  # KIT-236 (I05): a step without a label (the filter's Skip, `<prefix>_norm_complete`; a reset; a legacy step) is left
  # out: it changes no count, and an internal operation name is never printed.
  counts <- character()
  for (step in steps) {
    feature_rows <- step$dimensions$rows
    if (!is.numeric(feature_rows) || length(feature_rows) != 1L) next
    operation <- as.character(step$operation %||% "")
    key <- names(labels)[vapply(names(labels), function(k) identical(operation, k) || endsWith(operation, paste0("_", k)),
      logical(1))]
    if (length(key)) counts <- c(counts, paste(labels[[key[[1L]]]], feature_rows))
  }
  if (length(counts)) facts$step_features <- paste(counts, collapse = "; ")
  # The samples the sample-correlation filter kept, only when its step is in the record (KIT-236 I02): n = the samples
  # given to the filter, k = the samples of the record's analysed design; the filter's own removals are the step's
  # columns (samples plus a fixed number of id columns) less those of the step before it, so a sample that left the
  # design at an earlier step is not counted as the filter's.
  pearson_at <- which(vapply(steps, function(step) endsWith(as.character(step$operation %||% ""), "pearson_selection"),
    logical(1)))
  if (length(pearson_at) && length(rows)) {
    at <- pearson_at[[length(pearson_at)]]
    columns_of <- function(step) {
      value <- step$dimensions$columns
      if (is.numeric(value) && length(value) == 1L) value else NA_real_
    }
    before <- Filter(function(i) !is.na(columns_of(steps[[i]])), seq_len(at - 1L))
    removed <- if (length(before)) columns_of(steps[[before[[length(before)]]]]) - columns_of(steps[[at]]) else NA_real_
    threshold <- Filter(function(p) identical(p$name, "min_pearson_correlation_threshold"), steps[[at]]$parameters)
    if (!is.na(removed) && removed >= 0) {
      facts$samples_kept <- list(k = length(rows), n = length(rows) + removed,
        threshold = if (length(threshold)) decode(threshold[[1L]]$value) else NULL)
    }
    # KIT-255: the samples set missing in one assay (the step's outcome), named with the assay.
    excluded <- steps[[at]]$outcomes$correlation_excluded_per_assay
    if (length(excluded)) facts$samples_set_missing <- unlist(lapply(names(excluded), function(assay)
      paste0(names(excluded[[assay]]), " in ", assay)), use.names = FALSE)
  }
  # KIT-236 (I09): the comparisons and assays whose test could not be computed, as the record names them.
  failed <- da$failures %||% list()
  if (length(failed)) {
    facts$failures <- data.frame(
      contrast = vapply(failed, function(x) as.character(x$contrast %||% NA_character_), ""),
      assay = vapply(failed, function(x) as.character(x$assay %||% NA_character_), ""),
      error = vapply(failed, function(x) as.character(x$error %||% ""), ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  # KIT-236 (I01): the declared RUV design (KIT-129) tests the uncorrected values with each assay's factors in the model;
  # the RUV step's record names the design and the factors per assay.
  ruv_steps <- Filter(function(step) grepl("(^|_)ruv$", as.character(step$operation %||% "")), steps)
  if (length(ruv_steps)) {
    ruv_step <- ruv_steps[[length(ruv_steps)]]
    design_parameter <- Filter(function(p) identical(p$name, "ruv_design"), ruv_step$parameters)
    declared <- ruv_step$outcomes$ruv_design %||% (if (length(design_parameter)) decode(design_parameter[[1L]]$value))
    if (ReportKnown(declared)) {
      best_k <- ruv_step$outcomes$best_k
      facts$ruv_declared <- list(design = as.character(declared),
        k = if (is.list(best_k) && length(best_k) && !is.null(names(best_k))) {
          unlist(lapply(best_k, function(x) if (is.numeric(x) && length(x) == 1L) x else NA_real_))
        } else NULL)
    }
  }
  # Internal standards: the assays the file lists under 'ITSD Features Per Assay' (KIT-235's parser returns the block
  # as a section of its own).
  itsd_block <- study_params[["ITSD Features Per Assay"]] %||% study_params[["ITSD Normalization"]][["ITSD Features Per Assay"]]
  facts$itsd_assays_found <- length(itsd_block)
  # Whether a between-sample normalisation method is recorded (the file, the S4 parameters or a record step).
  norm_steps <- Filter(function(step) endsWith(as.character(step$operation %||% ""), "between_sample_normalisation") ||
    identical(step$operation, "normalization-ruv"), steps)
  facts$normalisation_recorded <- ReportKnown(study_params[["Between-Sample Normalization"]][["Method"]]) ||
    ReportKnown(study_params[["Workflow Parameters"]][["Parameters from Final S4 Object"]][["normaliseBetweenSamples"]][["method"]]) ||
    ReportKnown(study_params[["Workflow Parameters"]][["Parameters from Final S4 Object"]][["normaliseBetweenSamples"]][["normalisation_method"]]) ||
    length(norm_steps) > 0L
  facts
}

#' The sample-details sentence (D5): the analysed design from the record, else the design table
ReportDesignText <- function(facts) {
  design <- facts$design
  if (is.null(design)) return("The design is not available to this report.")
  lead <- if (identical(design$source, "record")) "The analysis included" else "The design table lists"
  runs <- design$runs
  ids <- design$ids
  if (is.null(ids) || all(is.na(ids))) {
    return(paste0(lead, " ", runs, " samples. The design does not record which, if any, are technical replicates."))
  }
  sizes <- table(ids)
  shared <- sum(sizes > 1L)
  biological <- length(sizes)
  if (shared == 0L) {
    return(paste0(lead, " ", runs, " samples, each a separate biological sample (no technical replicates were declared ",
      "in the design)."))
  }
  paste0(lead, " ", runs, " measured runs from ", biological, " biological samples; ", shared,
    if (shared == 1L) " biological sample was" else " biological samples were",
    " measured more than once (technical replicates), giving ", runs - biological, " additional runs.")
}

#' The between-sample normalisation as the Figure 1 caption names its column (D1, D2)
ReportNormalisationWords <- function(method, recorded = TRUE) {
  if (!isTRUE(recorded) || !ReportKnown(method)) return("between-sample normalisation (the method is not recorded)")
  switch(as.character(method),
    cyclicloess = "cyclic loess normalisation (normalizeCyclicLoess)",
    quantile = "quantile normalisation (normalizeQuantiles)",
    scale = "scaling of each sample to the same median absolute value (normalizeMedianAbsValues)",
    none = "the normalisation step, at which no normalisation was applied",
    paste0("between-sample normalisation with the '", method, "' method"))
}

#' Whether a fold-change threshold (TREAT) was tested (D20): the record's model, else the DA UI block, else the cutoff.
#' `record_only`: the record's model alone (DIA with limpa, whose DPC model runs no TREAT whatever the cutoff).
ReportTreatState <- function(numbers, record_only = FALSE) {
  cutoff <- NA_real_
  for (value in list(numbers$ui_de_log_fold_change_cutoff, numbers$s4_de_treat_lfc_cutoff)) {
    if (ReportKnown(value)) {
      cutoff <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
      if (!is.na(cutoff)) break
    }
  }
  applied <- numbers$report_facts$treat_applied
  if (is.logical(applied) && length(applied) == 1L && !is.na(applied)) {
    return(list(state = if (applied) "treat" else "zero", cutoff = cutoff))
  }
  if (isTRUE(record_only)) return(list(state = "unknown", cutoff = cutoff))
  enabled <- numbers$ui_de_treat_enabled
  if (is.logical(enabled) && length(enabled) == 1L && isFALSE(enabled)) return(list(state = "zero", cutoff = cutoff))
  if (is.na(cutoff)) return(list(state = "unknown", cutoff = cutoff))
  list(state = if (cutoff > 0) "treat" else "zero", cutoff = cutoff)
}

ReportTreatSentence <- function(treat) {
  if (identical(treat$state, "treat")) {
    if (is.na(treat$cutoff)) return(paste("Each comparison was tested against a log2 fold-change threshold with limma's",
      "TREAT method (McCarthy and Smyth, 2009); the threshold is not recorded."))
    return(paste0("Each comparison was tested against a log2 fold-change threshold of ", treat$cutoff,
      " with limma's TREAT method (McCarthy and Smyth, 2009)."))
  }
  if (identical(treat$state, "zero")) return("Each comparison was tested for any difference from zero log2 fold change.")
  "Whether a fold-change threshold (TREAT) was used is not recorded for this analysis."
}

#' The definition of a significant feature (D21)
ReportSignificanceSentence <- function(treat, q_value, features) {
  if (identical(treat$state, "treat") && !is.na(treat$cutoff)) {
    return(paste0("Differentially abundant ", features, " were those with a q-value below ", q_value,
      " and an absolute log2 fold change of at least ", treat$cutoff, "."))
  }
  if (identical(treat$state, "zero")) return(paste0("Differentially abundant ", features, " were those with a q-value below ",
    q_value, "."))
  paste0("Differentially abundant ", features, " were those with a q-value below ", q_value,
    "; whether a fold-change threshold also applied is not recorded.")
}

#' The false discovery rate sentence (D11): per comparison where the record names the method, else the rule
ReportFdrSentence <- function(numbers) {
  facts <- numbers$report_facts
  fdr <- facts$fdr
  if (is.null(fdr) || !nrow(fdr)) {
    return(paste("False discovery rates were estimated as q-values (Storey, 2002); where they cannot be computed,",
      "Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values are used."))
  }
  fallback <- fdr[fdr$fdr_method == "BH", , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(fallback)) return("False discovery rates were estimated as q-values (Storey, 2002).")
  names_of <- function(x) {
    hit <- unname(facts$contrasts[x])
    ifelse(is.na(hit), x, hit)
  }
  groups <- split(fallback, ifelse(is.na(fallback$assay), "", fallback$assay))
  parts <- vapply(groups, function(rows) {
    comparisons <- paste(unique(names_of(rows$contrast)), collapse = ", ")
    if (is.na(rows$assay[[1L]])) comparisons else paste0(comparisons, " in ", rows$assay[[1L]])
  }, "")
  paste0("False discovery rates were estimated as q-values (Storey, 2002), except for ", paste(parts, collapse = "; "),
    ", where q-values could not be computed and Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values were used instead.")
}

#' The comparisons named after "the contrast table" (D10): " (1 comparison: A_vs_B)", or nothing when unknown
ReportContrastList <- function(numbers) {
  friendly <- unname(numbers$report_facts$contrasts %||% character())
  friendly <- friendly[!is.na(friendly) & nzchar(friendly)]
  if (!length(friendly)) return("")
  paste0(" (", length(friendly), if (length(friendly) == 1L) " comparison: " else " comparisons: ",
    paste(friendly, collapse = ", "), ")")
}

#' KIT-236 (I06): how the p-values were computed: limma's TREAT test at a fold-change threshold above 0, else eBayes
ReportPvalueClause <- function(treat) {
  if (identical(treat$state, "treat")) {
    return(paste("the variances were moderated with limma's empirical Bayes method ('eBayes'), and p-values were",
      "calculated with limma's TREAT test against the fold-change threshold"))
  }
  if (identical(treat$state, "zero")) return("p-values were calculated using the 'eBayes' function")
  paste("p-values were calculated with limma's moderated t-test ('eBayes'), or with its TREAT test if a fold-change",
    "threshold was used (not recorded)")
}

#' KIT-236 (I07): the second criterion of significance at a fold-change threshold, for the count and volcano sentences
ReportFoldChangeCriterion <- function(treat) {
  if (identical(treat$state, "treat") && !is.na(treat$cutoff)) {
    paste0(" and an absolute log2 fold change of at least ", treat$cutoff)
  } else ""
}

#' KIT-236 (I08): a contrast as the DA paragraph names it (the record's friendly name), else as given
ReportComparisonName <- function(contrast, contrasts) {
  hit <- if (length(contrasts)) unname(contrasts[as.character(contrast)]) else rep(NA_character_, length(contrast))
  ifelse(is.na(hit), as.character(contrast), hit)
}

#' KIT-236 (I09): the comparisons and assays whose test could not be computed, with the error the record holds
ReportFailureText <- function(numbers) {
  failures <- numbers$report_facts$failures
  if (is.null(failures) || !nrow(failures)) return("")
  names <- ReportComparisonName(failures$contrast, numbers$report_facts$contrasts)
  items <- paste0(names, ifelse(is.na(failures$assay), "", paste0(" in ", failures$assay)),
    ifelse(nzchar(failures$error), paste0(" (", failures$error, ")"), ""))
  paste0(" The test could not be computed for ", paste(items, collapse = "; "), ".")
}

#' The technical-replicate block (D10): when the record's block reason contains 'technical_replicates'
ReportBlockClause <- function(numbers, per_assay = TRUE) {
  reason <- numbers$report_facts$block_reason
  if (!ReportKnown(reason)) reason <- numbers$da_block_reason
  if (!ReportKnown(reason) || !grepl("technical_replicates", reason, fixed = TRUE)) return("")
  if (isTRUE(per_assay)) {
    " Technical replicates were modelled as a block through limma's duplicateCorrelation (consensus correlation estimated per assay)."
  } else " Technical replicates were modelled as a block through limma's duplicateCorrelation."
}

CalculateSampleCounts <- function(group_summary) {
  if (is.null(group_summary) || nrow(group_summary) == 0) {
    return(list(total_samples = 0, biological_samples = 0, technical_replicates = 0))
  }

  total_measurements <- sum(group_summary$total_measurements, na.rm = TRUE)
  biological_samples <- sum(group_summary$n_samples, na.rm = TRUE)
  technical_replicates <- max(0, total_measurements - biological_samples)

  list(
    total_samples = total_measurements,
    biological_samples = biological_samples,
    technical_replicates = technical_replicates
  )
}

CalculatePatientMetrics <- function(numbers, group_summary) {
  if (is.null(numbers) || is.null(group_summary)) return(numbers)

  if (numbers$biological_samples > 0) {
    numbers$avg_tech_reps_per_sample <- numbers$total_samples / numbers$biological_samples
    numbers$samples_per_group <- numbers$biological_samples / n_distinct(group_summary$group)
  } else {
    numbers$avg_tech_reps_per_sample <- 0
    numbers$samples_per_group <- 0
  }
  numbers
}

AnalyzeGroups <- function(design_df) {
  if (is.null(design_df) || nrow(design_df) == 0 || !"group" %in% names(design_df)) {
    return(tibble(group = character(0), n_samples = numeric(0),
                  total_measurements = numeric(0), avg_replicates = numeric(0)))
  }

  unique(design_df$group) |>
    purrr::map_dfr(function(g) {
      group_data <- design_df |>
        filter(group == g)
      unique_samples <- n_distinct(group_data$Run)
      total_rows <- nrow(group_data)
      avg_reps <- if(unique_samples == total_rows) 1 else total_rows / unique_samples
      tibble( group = g, n_samples = unique_samples, total_measurements = total_rows, avg_replicates = avg_reps )
    })
}

AnalyzeSamples <- function(design_matrix, study_params) {
  tryCatch({
    group_summary <- AnalyzeGroups(design_matrix)
    numbers <- CalculateSampleCounts(group_summary)
    numbers <- CalculatePatientMetrics(numbers, group_summary)
    params_extracted <- ExtractStudyParametersNew(study_params)
    # KIT-032: the analysis record, when it sits beside study_parameters.txt, supplies the values it carries
    # (the KIT-033 overlay); without one the parameters stay as parsed.
    params_extracted <- MultiScholaR:::workflowRecordReportParameters(file.path(report_source_dir, "analysis_record.json"),
      params_extracted, study_params)
      # KIT-227: the RUV step's own parameters (stored encoded; the overlay does not map them): the mode, the analyst's
      # percentage and the grouping the RUV sentence states.
      record_ruv_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "analysis_record.json")
      record_ruv_steps <- if (file.exists(record_ruv_path)) Filter(function(step) identical(step$operation, "metab_ruv"),
        jsonlite::read_json(record_ruv_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)$steps) else list()
      record_ruv_parameter <- function(name) {
        hit <- if (length(record_ruv_steps)) Filter(function(parameter) identical(parameter$name, name),
          record_ruv_steps[[length(record_ruv_steps)]]$parameters) else list()
        if (length(hit)) MultiScholaR:::decodeWorkflowRecordValue(hit[[1L]]$value) else NULL
      }
      params_extracted$record_ruv_mode <- record_ruv_parameter("ruv_mode")
      params_extracted$record_ruv_percentage <- record_ruv_parameter("manual_percentage")
      params_extracted$record_ruv_grouping <- record_ruv_parameter("ruv_grouping_variable")

    # Combine counts with extracted params
    final_numbers <- c(numbers, params_extracted)

    # Replace NULLs with NA
    final_numbers[sapply(final_numbers, is.null)] <- NA
    # KIT-236: the record and design facts of the computed sentences (ReportRecordFacts)
    final_numbers$report_facts <- tryCatch(ReportRecordFacts(design_matrix, study_params), error = function(e) list())
    # KIT-129 sixth pass item 6: a new RUV design's methods sentence, from the study parameters' section
    # "Unwanted variation (RUV)" (absent for today's design, whose text is unchanged)
    ruv_design_methods <- safe_extract(study_params, c("Unwanted variation (RUV)", "Methods text"), NULL)
    if (is.character(ruv_design_methods) && length(ruv_design_methods) == 1L && nzchar(ruv_design_methods)) final_numbers$ruv_design_methods <- ruv_design_methods

    list( numbers = final_numbers, table = group_summary )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(numbers = list(), table = data.frame())
  })
}

# Format DE Summary Table
FormatDESummaryTable <- function(filepath, figure_present = FALSE, treat = NULL, contrasts = NULL) {
  if (!file.exists(filepath)) return("")

  tryCatch({
    data <- readr::read_tsv(filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # KIT-236 (F6, D22): the table Copy writes for lipidomics and metabolomics has one row per comparison and assay
    # (up_regulated, down_regulated, assay, contrast, q_threshold); the counts are stated per comparison and assay, and
    # Figure 2 is named only when it is drawn.
    if (all(c("up_regulated", "down_regulated", "contrast") %in% names(data))) {
      # KIT-236 (I07): at a fold-change threshold the counts also used |log2 FC| >= c, as stated.
      q_text <- if ("q_threshold" %in% names(data)) paste0(" (q-value < ", paste(unique(data$q_threshold), collapse = ", "),
        ReportFoldChangeCriterion(treat %||% list(state = "unknown")), ")") else ""
      if (!nrow(data) || sum(data$up_regulated + data$down_regulated, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
        return(paste0("No significant differentially abundant metabolites were found", q_text, "."))
      }
      assay_text <- if ("assay" %in% names(data)) paste0(" in ", data$assay) else ""
      # KIT-236 (I08): the comparison as the DA paragraph names it.
      rows_text <- paste0("For the comparison ", ReportComparisonName(data$contrast, contrasts), assay_text, ", there were ", data$up_regulated,
        " upregulated and ", data$down_regulated, " downregulated metabolites.")
      lead <- if (isTRUE(figure_present)) {
        paste0("The number of significant differentially abundant metabolites is summarised in Figure 2", q_text, ".")
      } else paste0("Significant differentially abundant metabolites", q_text, ", by comparison and assay:")
      return(paste(c(lead, rows_text), collapse = " "))
    }

    sig_data <- data %>%
      dplyr::filter(status %in% c("Significant and Up", "Significant and Down"))

    if (nrow(sig_data) == 0) return("No significant differentially abundant metabolites were found.")

    summary_text <- sig_data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        up = sum(counts[status == "Significant and Up"]),
        down = sum(counts[status == "Significant and Down"]),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        text = glue::glue("For the comparison {comparison}, there were {up} upregulated and {down} downregulated metabolites.")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(text) %>%
      paste(collapse = " ")

    if (!isTRUE(figure_present)) return(summary_text)
    return(paste("The number of significant differentially abundant metabolites is summarised in Figure 2.", summary_text))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(paste("Error reading DE summary table:", e$message))
  })
}
```

```{r Main Execution Function, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Main <- function() {
  # Use globally available path variables
  params_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "study_parameters.txt")
  if (!file.exists(params_path)) stop(glue::glue("Study parameters file not found: {params_path}"))

  # Use hierarchical parser
  study_params_data <- tryCatch({
    ReadStudyParamsNew(params_path)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(glue::glue("Error reading study parameters: {e$message}"))
  })

  matrix_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "design_matrix.tab")
  if (!file.exists(matrix_path)) stop(glue::glue("Design matrix file not found: {matrix_path}"))
  design_matrix_data <- tryCatch({
    readr::read_tsv(matrix_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(glue::glue("Error reading design matrix: {e$message}"))
  })

  # Correlation data - check for both RUV and non-RUV filenames
  ruv_corr_path <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, "ruv_normalised_results.RDS")
  norm_corr_path <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, "normalised_results.RDS")

  # Try RUV filename first, then fall back
  corr_path <- if (file.exists(ruv_corr_path)) {
    ruv_corr_path
  } else if (file.exists(norm_corr_path)) {
    norm_corr_path
  } else {
    ruv_corr_path
  }

  correlation_data <- if (file.exists(corr_path)) {
    tryCatch({ readRDS(corr_path) }, error = function(e) { warning(glue::glue("Error reading RDS: {e$message}")); list() })
  } else { warning(glue::glue("File not found: {corr_path}")); list() }

  # Run analysis
  analysis_results <- tryCatch({
    AnalyzeSamples(design_matrix_data, study_params_data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop(glue::glue("Error in AnalyzeSamples: {e$message}"))
  })

  # Get DE summary
  # KIT-236 (F6): Copy writes the table as da_<omic>_num_sig_de_molecules.tab; the older de_ name is read too.
  de_summary_candidates <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, paste0(c("da_", "de_"), params$omic_type,
    "_num_sig_de_molecules.tab"))
  de_summary_path <- c(de_summary_candidates[file.exists(de_summary_candidates)], de_summary_candidates)[[1L]]
  num_sig_figure <- length(ReportImages("report_publication_figures_dir", "NumSigDeMolecules")) > 0L
  de_summary_text <- FormatDESummaryTable(de_summary_path, figure_present = num_sig_figure,
    treat = ReportTreatState(analysis_results$numbers), contrasts = analysis_results$numbers$report_facts$contrasts)

  # Generate sections
  report_content <- list(
    content = list(
      sample_details = FormatSampleDetails(analysis_results$numbers),
      method_details = FormatMethodDetails(analysis_results$numbers),
      results        = FormatResults(correlation_data, ruv_applied = analysis_results$numbers$ruv_applied %||% NA, numbers = analysis_results$numbers), # KIT-227: NA = not recorded
      comments       = FormatComments(analysis_results$numbers),
      opinions       = FormatOpinions(correlation_data),
      de_details     = FormatDEDetails(analysis_results$numbers),
      de_summary     = de_summary_text,
      pathway_enrichment  = FormatPathwayEnrichment(analysis_results$numbers)
    ),
    table = analysis_results$table,
    numbers = analysis_results$numbers
  )
  return(report_content)
}

# Execute Main
results_data <- tryCatch({
  Main()
}, error = function(e) {
  list(content = list(
    sample_details = paste("Error running Main function:", e$message),
    method_details = "",
    results = "",
    comments = "",
    opinions = "",
    de_details = "",
    de_summary = "",
    pathway_enrichment = ""
  ), table = data.frame(), numbers = list())
})
```

# Pathway Enrichment Analysis

`r results_data$content$pathway_enrichment`

```{r Enrichment Plots, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%", out.height="49%", fig.align='center', fig.ncol=2, fig.show='hold'}
enrichment_plots_dir <- file.path(report_publication_figures_dir, "Enrichment_Plots")
if(dir.exists(enrichment_plots_dir)) {
  all_enrichment_files <- list.files(enrichment_plots_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  enrichment_plot_files <- sort(grep(pattern = "[.](png|jpg|jpeg)$", x = all_enrichment_files, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE))
  if(length(enrichment_plot_files) > 0) {
    knitr::include_graphics(enrichment_plot_files)
  } else {
     cat(glue::glue("Warning: No Enrichment Plot images found in {enrichment_plots_dir}\n"))
  }
} else {
  cat(glue::glue("Warning: Enrichment Plots directory not found at {enrichment_plots_dir}\n"))
}
```

```{r Enrichment Caption, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("*Figure 4: Pathway enrichment analysis showing pathways enriched in differentially abundant metabolites. Plots are ordered alphabetically by comparison and direction.*\n\n")
```
